system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature

Mutated Trait: Sharingan

You fail to manifest the clans Dojutsu. This absence was possible, but you expected this. Something inside warned you. And so, you trained until your technique and skill rivaled Uchiha with their Sharingan, even surpassing them in some areas. When you gain this feature mutation, you master two secret battle stances, taught to Uchiha incapable of awakening the Sharingan. The Flaming Spark chakra stance and the Blazing Fan Bukijutsu stance, of which you can benefit from both at the same time. If you have the Agile Fist adaptation, you can benefit from it, and either Flaming Spark or Blazing Fan, but never all three. As part of gaining this mutation, you also gain access to an Uchiha clan designed weapon a Gunbai Fan.

Flaming Spark. You build flaming chakra in your lungs until each word you speak is followed by spark of ember or whisps of smoke. You can enter this stance as a bonus action. While you are in this stance you gain the following benefits;

As an Action, you can perform the Flame Flower attack. Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can make two attack with Flame Flower.

When you cast a Jutsu with the Fire Release keyword, you become Enflamed until the end of your next turn. While Enflamed, attacks you make that would deal fire damage gain a +1 bonus to their critical threat range.

Flame Flower. Make ranged Jutsu attack, using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 60 feet of you, spitting a ball of flame that deals 2d6+2 fire damage on a hit and forcing them to make a Dexterity or Constitution saving throw vs your attack types associated saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save. Beginning at 7th level, increase the damage dealt by 1d6+1

Blazing Fan. You take hold of your clans weapon of choice, the Gunbai fan. While wielding a Gunbai Fan, you can enter this stance as a bonus action. While in this stance you gain the following benefits;

The Gunbai Fan gains 1 rank of the Blocking property.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can make two attacks with the Gunbai Fan, as part of the Attack action.

As an Action, you can perform the Fanned Wind attack.

As a reaction to taking damage from a Ninjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu, you can perform the Uchiha Return.

Fanned Wind. You swipe your fan, creating a massive wave of force. All creatures in a 30-foot cone originating from you must make a Strength saving throw, vs your highest jutsu save DC, taking [Weapon Damage] + [Weapon Damage] and being pushed back 20 feet on a failed save. Beginning at 7th level, when you use this attack, you can choose to increase the size of the cone by 10-feet or the damage dealt by + [Weapon Damage].

Uchiha Return. You swipe your fan, initiating a Clash, using your highest skill between Ninshou, Martial Arts or Chakra Control.

If you take this mutation, you must also take the Heightened Battle Sense Uchiha mutation.
